title: My brother and I can't agree on this. Which ship destruction looks better?
author: wit1200
selftext:
We recently changed how ship destruction looks.

I really like the new version, but my brother still prefers the old one 😭

So we need some outside opinions. Which one looks better to you, old or new?

comments.author: ThickBootyEnjoyer
comments.body: The pieces coming off felt more like disintegration, dissolving, than destruction by missiles and explosions.

comments.author: barkywoodson
comments.body: Bigger chunks, by a longshot. Looks dope.

comments.author: MistakeExotic6686
comments.body: Could depend on weapon being used, a laser would unpixelify a ship, rockets take a chunk

comments.author: InsensitiveClown
comments.body: The pixel by pixel case makes the ship look like it's solid, a pure block of metal being chirped away. The one with tiny pieces looks like a ship, something designed, built, with a hull, an interior, a ship. Just my .02c.

comments.author: Coors44
comments.body: Why are the bullets defying the laws of physics and all curving around after being shot, instead of firing directly from the gun to the enemy ship?

comments.author: loontoon
comments.body:
I've been following your posts and at first I thought the pixel by pixel idea was quite good.  But now I don't think either version looks realistic.  

The ship being attacked should break up and explode unless you're not aiming for realism.
